notes.title: v1.05 Update
notes.content:
Update note:

-Added volumetric lights
-Added real-time reflection for high-end PCs
-Added the version number on the main menu
-Reduced item removal time from 1min to 30sec


Note:
Volumetric light and real-time reflection are disabled on default. (Can be toggled on in the pause menu)
Free roam mode (in the pause menu) disables item pickup and ball mesh which allows the player to take screenshots close up.

Stay tuned for future updates!

Twitter: https://twitter.com/ChillasArt
